This is not just 'slight distortion' (Severity 2) but a fundamental failure of text generation (Severity 4-5). AI-generated text that mimics script structure but lacks semantic or orthographic validity is a major artifact. The Router also noted edge bleeding (Severity 1), which is consistent with the `topology_boundary_auditor`'s high confidence mask but visually apparent softness. The perspective distortion in the background is minor (Severity 1) and acceptable.
